news.title: Niclas Füllkrug hits 10-goal milestone in resounding Nordderby triumph
news.summary: On-song Niclas Füllkrug became the first player to reach 10 Bundesliga goals this season, and he did so in style, smashing home a stoppage-time thunderbolt to cap off Werder Bremen's 4-0 demolition of Hamburg and help maintain their strong start to 2026/27.
news.title_tr: Niclas Füllkrug, ses getiren Nordderby zaferinde 10 gollük dönüm noktasına ulaştı

news.title: 'You question everything' - Haaland lays City's frustrations bare
news.summary: Erling Haaland has admitted Manchester City's poor form is affecting the players, admitting "when you don't win, you question everything" after they were held 2-2 at home by Napoli in the Champions League.

news.title: Real Madrid geheimzinnig na ommekeer tegen PSV: 'Kleedkamer net als Las Vegas'
news.summary: De twee helften die Real Madrid tegen PSV op de mat legde in de Champions League, waren een wereld van verschil. José Mourinho wilde niet kwijt wat hij de selectie van De Koninklijke in de rust had verteld, al lichtte Jude Bellingham wel een tipje van de sluier.

news.title: 'Zidane beleefde een wedergeboorte in Bellingham: een allesverwoestende engel'

news.summary_tr: İspanyol medyasına göre Real Madrid'in PSV'ye karşı kazandığı zafer Jude Bellingham'ın sayesinde geldi. İngiliz yıldızın gelişinin ardından maç İspanyolların lehine döndü. "Bellingham geldiğinde her şey değişti."

news.title: Schalke legend Raúl recalls ‘unforgettable, magical’ time in Gelsenkirchen
